candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503, order POST /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502 with ~2s durations.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs to confirm the underlying redis fault versus network or saturation.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating up through inventory (503), order (ReadTimeout/502) and gateway checkout (502, ~2s), matching the alert. Topology confirms inventory depends on redis. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Bounded to redis-timeout; redis-side evidence is missing.
